proposedModuleMemory.statement: P0 Originate has shadow ready candidate evidence, but it remains inactive until operator-approved promotion and signed-in runtime proof.
P1 Charter has partially ready candidate evidence, but it remains inactive until operator-approved promotion and signed-in runtime proof.
P2 Understand Current State has shadow ready candidate evidence, but it remains inactive until operator-approved promotion and signed-in runtime proof.
P3 Choose the Approach has shadow ready candidate evidence, but it remains inactive until operator-approved promotion and signed-in runtime proof.
P4 Build the Plan has partially ready candidate evidence, but it remains inactive until operator-approved promotion and signed-in runtime proof.
P5 Prepare to Execute has blocked candidate evidence, but it remains inactive until operator-approved promotion and signed-in runtime proof.

proposedValueThemes: disruption events: OCC disruption management console and disruption events evidence show a blocker for IROPS AI recovery cockpit: No approved disruption recovery baseline
flight status: Flight operations dispatch platform and flight status evidence show a blocker for IROPS AI recovery cockpit: No certified operational event spine
crew legality: Crew scheduling and legality platform and crew legality evidence show a blocker for IROPS AI recovery cockpit: Crew legality control evidence not loaded
customer reaccommodation: Passenger service system and customer reaccommodation evidence show a blocker for IROPS AI recovery cockpit: Customer reaccommodation SLA not validated
crew pairings: Crew scheduling and legality platform and crew pairings evidence show a blocker for Crew recovery decision support: Legality rules owner not signed off
legality constraints: OCC disruption management console and legality constraints evidence show a blocker for Crew recovery decision support: Crew mobile feedback not loaded
reserve assignment: IBM MQ / integration backbone and reserve assignment evidence show a blocker for Crew recovery decision support: Human approval workflow not evidenced
hotel transport: Airline operations data lake candidate and hotel transport evidence show a blocker for Crew recovery decision support: Data freshness SLA not loaded
requiredBeforeCommitment: Signed-in Moves runtime proof against an active promoted slice.
Human-approved phase gate decision with evidence trace.
Tower outcome commitment written through a future approved Outcome Ledger path.
